gates.rule: Caption and section co-location may establish a secondary image-witness inventory, but cannot establish glyph identity before image bytes are inspected.
A connector content-type or direct-open failure is ACCESS_FAILURE, not evidence that the image is absent.
AUDIT_PASS requires object ID plus direct primary report caption/table and an inspectable photo, drawing, or rubbing.
When multiple assets share one caption and bytes are unseen, page order cannot assign LINE_DRAWING, RUBBING, front, or reverse roles.
Repeated access failures through different retrieval routes may close a route as blocked, but cannot raise evidence status or resolve asset roles.

next_lookup_key: Use an authorized byte-capable image downloader or obtain the original report pages 34–35; then record byte length, SHA-256, media type, dimensions, and visual role before glyph adjudication.
